fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains ''On the Hunt'' for a duration and grants it to nearby allied champions for the remaining duration.
fields.description3: While active, '''Sivir's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} reduce her basic abilities' {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds each.
fields.description4: '''Sivir''' can refresh the duration of her ''On the Hunt'' buff whenever she scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them.
